cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline multilingual exam tutor for African secondary students: WAEC, NECO, GCE and JAMB-style practice solved step-by-step in Yoruba, Hausa, Swahili, Igbo and English, grounded in AfriGSM math word problems and past-paper question banks.

test_prompts.prompt: A trader buys a bag of rice for N24,000 and sells it for N30,000. Calculate the percentage profit and show your working step by step.
Oníṣòwò kan ra àpò ìrẹsì kan ní N24,000, ó sì tà á ní N30,000. Ṣe ìṣirò ìpín ọgọ́rùn-ún èrè rẹ̀, kí o sì ṣàlàyé ìgbésẹ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan.
